messages:
ashok: quick idea — what if we add a lightweight, client-provided checksum for embeddings payloads to help routing and dedupe preflight?
olivia: interesting. the goal is to avoid unnecessary splits when clients resend identical batched vectors?
jin: yeah. we keep getting requests where 90% of vectors are duplicates from featurestore replays. splitter is doing work for nothing.
sam: curious about semantics. if a checksum says two items are identical, do we force them to the same shard, or short-circuit and return cached embedding?
ashok: typo — i meant ashok :)
ashok: sorry — yes, option A: route identical checksums to same slot to batch compute; option B: short-circuit and fetch cached vector if present. we can do both with a header mode.
eve: (console-team) From UX/telemetry side we need metrics: checksum_hit_rate, dedup_savings_tokens, split_rate_drop. We should show an estimate in the console of cost saved by dedupe.
olivia: protocol idea: client can send header X-Embed-Checksum: sha256:abcd1234 for each input item OR per-batch header indicating canonicalization. server validates length and format, not value.
jin: small proto: ```json
{"items": [{"id": "u1", "vector": "..", "checksum": "sha256:..."}, ...]}
```
sam: runtime concerns: attacker could craft many distinct checksums to force caching state growth. need TTL + per-tenant limit.
ashok: agreed. propose TTL=24h, per-tenant max cached keys configurable via quota. default 10k keys. console should expose current cache_size and eviction_rate.
eve: add telemetry tags: tenant_id, route, checksum_present boolean, dedupe_hit boolean. Dashboards: heatmap over routes showing dedupe savings.
olivia: routing heuristics: if a batch has >75% identical checksum, route it to small-batch fastpath on a single slot to reduce inter-shard comms. otherwise use existing splitter. that avoids fragmentation.
jin: fallback behavior: if checksum claims identical but vectors differ (malformed), we must validate hash on ingress and fall back to regular path. validation adds CPU — maybe do probabilistic validate (1% sample) for new tenants.
sam: quota interaction: treat cached-retrieval as cheaper unit for quota (0.1 cost) vs compute (1.0). But that could be gamed. QA: require auth+quota guardrail for cheap units.
eve: console rollout plan: flag "embed.dedupe.v1" in FF service. show a rollout slider per org. telemetry only flips when enabled. also add a safety toggle to disable short-circuiting (keep routing-only).
ashok: rollout plan suggestion: stage 1: routing-only (route identical checksums together) with FF on 5% tenants; stage 2: enable cache short-circuit for 1% tenants with stricter quotas; stage 3: expand with telemetry thresholds.
jin: instrumentation: emit events: checksum_validation_time_ms, dedupe_cache_lookup_ms, dedupe_cache_hit=true/false, dedupe_bytes_saved. Also breaker counters when cache_size > quota.
olivia: SDK change: add helper to compute checksum on client side. fallback server-side if SDK not updated. But server-side compute cost is heavy. prefer client.
sam: security note: require checksum header to be optional. if present, treat as hint. only trust it after we validated once.
eve: console widgets: 1) Dedup Savings KPI (tokens and $ saved last 24h) 2) Cache Health panel (size/evict_rate/avg_ttl) 3) Route Cohesion (percent of batches routed to single slot). Also an Explorer to list top checksum keys by tenant.
ashok: operations: add rate limiter to checksum validation path. also a job to evict stale keys and emit evict metrics.
jin: edge-case: mixed-dim batches — checksum should be per-item; identical checksums only meaningful if dims match. we must include dims in checksum input canonicalization.
olivia: propose checksum canonicalization = sha256(dims + '|' + normalized_bytes) and require header prefix "dim:128:sha256:..." for clarity.
sam: telemetry label idea: dedupe_mode = [hint-only, routing, shortcircuit]. helps to break down savings.
eve: question: do we expose dedupe credits in tenant quota UI? ops: might confuse customers. maybe show estimated savings but bill as usual unless they opt-in.
ashok: legal: confirm caching of embeddings is okay for customer PII — ops to validate with security/compliance.
ashok: quick action items: 1) design API header + SDK helpers (olivia+jin) 2) runtime prototype routing-only (ashok+sam) 3) console telemetry panels + FF (eve + console-team) 4) security/compliance check (sam)
eve: rolling canary: deploy-bot: deploy started for service=embed-splitter tag=dedupe-routing-canary id=canary-20260321-1 :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy success service=embed-splitter id=canary-20260321-1 host=slot-batch-12
ashok: I'll pair with ops to monitor dedupe_hit_rate and evict_rate for the next 2 hours. ping me if rate > 2% error.
jin: noted. will push SDK PR with checksum helper and tests.
olivia: wrote down RFC skeleton, linking in thread: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/embedding-dedupe (draft)
sam: thanks. let's reconvene after first-hour metrics. :thumbsup:
